title: AudioMeterSkin
description: Canonical skin descriptor for the rlvgl audio-meters initiative. A skin binds a scale + ballistic + colour palette + layout into a named look-and-feel preset. See docs/audio-meters/00-concepts.md §3 (skin glossary entry) and docs/audio-meters/04-skins.md.

id.description: Unique identifier. Lowercase snake_case. MUST match filename stem.

title.description: Short human-readable name shown in pickers and design-tool surfaces.

scale_id.description: References assets/audio-meters/scales/<scale_id>.json. The validator asserts this scale exists and that `default_ballistic` is in its `compatible_ballistics` (warn-only — non-conventional pairings are permitted).

default_ballistic.description: Ballistic variant from concepts §5. Widgets MAY override at instantiation.

calibration_override.description: Optional override of the scale's `calibration_default`. Same shape as the scale's field.

meter_type.description: Widget family this skin is intended for. Widgets pick skins matching their family.

palette.description: Concrete colours bound to the §7 MeterColor identifiers. Every identifier present in the bound scale's zones MUST have a palette entry. Colours are RGB hex (`#RRGGBB`) or RGBA hex (`#RRGGBBAA`).

secondary_colors.description: Optional non-zone colours: background, scale text, frame, needle. All optional — widget chooses sensible defaults when missing.

layout.description: Geometry hints for the widget. The widget owns final pixel layout; these are guidelines that survive resizing.

aspect_ratio.description: Width:height ratio. e.g. 0.2 for a tall thin bargraph; 1.6 for a wide horizontal needle.

led_count.description: For bargraph meter_type: number of LED segments to draw across the scale. Widgets MAY render solid fill instead and ignore this hint.

peak_hold_ms.description: How long the peak-hold pip stays at its maximum before decaying, in milliseconds. 0 disables peak hold. Widget owns the decay rate; this is the hold time.

assets.description: Optional pointers to visual primitives (filename references under assets/audio-meters/{svg,png}/). Owned by AM-04b — listed here so the schema is forward-compatible. AM-04a skins do not populate this field.
